name: AXM Dual Door Observatory
actions: inventory optional manifest-declared machine action entries
separate string-array and object-map action declaration shapes
check entry path presence without loading entry code
prepare one exact human-door or machine-action review request without opening or executing it
summary: Read-only map of human workspace doors and optional machine action doors declared by top-level Workshop modules.
notes: Optional machine-door absence is not a defect. A review request contains no command, arguments, environment values, or fixture and cannot open or execute itself. This observatory does not load UI or machine code, execute actions, require action parity, grant permissions, prove readiness, or change CANON.
